purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system — patient registration screen editing and SPA initial setup subprogram
purpose.summary: ORCSP02 is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It handles patient registration screen editing and initial SPA (Scratch Pad Area) parameter setup. It processes INIT and GMN events, managing patient master data, insurance combination records, and various medical-administrative master files via COPY-included record layouts.

notable_features: 54 COPY statements for record layouts and shared areas
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING with multiple SPA linkage areas (ORCA pattern)
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP DB access layer (MCPDATA.INC)
329 PERFORM statements indicating structured modular design
Zoned-decimal display fields (PIC Z) for screen formatting
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding, decoded as latin-1 producing mojibake. File is part of the open-source JMA ORCA project. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 201166 bytes (4490 lines); full procedure division not visible but structure is clear from headers and working-storage. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial/medical domain — likely uses display arithmetic or relies on copybook definitions.
